title: Flow Preview Wire Bezier
description: The preview wire for connection should use the same bezier curve as committed edges, not a straight line. Must work in both directions (drag from source or target port).
summary: Fixed preview wire endpoint tangent direction. Free cursor ends now place the target control point on the incoming side (-chord) so the curve arrives along the drag direction. Anchored ports use `handle_outward_at_node_rim` edge normals (not center radial) for both preview and committed edges via `wire_bezier_between` / `compute_edge_bezier_outward`.
